== Biography ==
Alexander Glasgow was born on March 17, 1799, in Colinton, Midlothian, Scotland. He was baptized on March 31, 1799, in the same place. His residence was in Greysmill. His father's name was John Glasgow, and his mother was Margaret Muckle. The baptismal records are part of the Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms collection, specifically from the year range 1738-1819. The archive reference for these records is OPR 677/2, and the entry is found on page 253. This collection falls under the category of Birth, Marriage, Death & Parish Records, with a subcategory of Parish Baptisms.

Title	Trial papers of John Paterson, wright, and Alexander Glasgow, blacksmith, prisoners in the tolbooth of Edinburgh, for the crime of theft by means of housebreaking.
Name	Alexander Glasgow
Role	Accused

Crime	Theft by means of housebreaking
